evidence: Tantalum oxide was grown on p-type Si (100) wafer at 260°C using Ta(OC2H5)5 as a precursor of Ta and oxygen radicals as a reactant. One deposition cycle consisted of an exposure to Ta(OC2H5)5 for 20 s, a purge period with argon for 7 s, and an exposure to oxygen plasma for 4 s, followed by another purge period with argon.
